parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $env.POSTCALL_MODEL || 'claude-sonnet-4-5', max_tokens: 1024, system: 'You are the post-call analyst for a dental receptionist. Extract intent, outcome, sentiment and follow-up need FROM THE TRANSCRIPT ONLY. Never invent detail the call did not contain. If you are not sure, say so in the summary and set the field to null. Respond with JSON only: { summary: string, intent: string (booking|reschedule|cancel|question|escalation|other), outcome: string|null, escalated: boolean, needs_followup: boolean, sentiment: string (positive|neutral|negative|frustrated) }', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: $json.transcript_text }] }) }}

parameters.query:
-- calls.location_id is a foreign key, so the location row must exist
-- before the call can be stored. Idempotent: a location that already exists
-- is left untouched (its real business hours and escalation number are not
-- overwritten by the transport payload).
INSERT INTO locations (location_id, business_name, timezone, calendar_id)
VALUES ($1, COALESCE(NULLIF($2, ''), 'Unknown practice'), 'America/New_York', '')
ON CONFLICT (location_id) DO NOTHING;

-- Idempotent on call_id: transports resend webhooks, so a retried run
-- must not duplicate or clobber the row. Outcome is only ever written when
-- the row is new -- a call that already booked must not be re-labelled
-- 'escalated' because post-call processing ran after the booking.
INSERT INTO calls
  (call_id, location_id, transport, direction, from_phone,
   started_at, ended_at, duration_secs, outcome,
   transcript, recording_url, summary, intent)
VALUES
  ($1, $2, 'voice', 'inbound', NULLIF($3, ''),
   NULLIF($4, '')::timestamptz, NULLIF($5, '')::timestamptz, NULLIF($6, 0),
   NULLIF($7, ''),
   NULLIF($8, '')::jsonb, NULLIF($9, ''), NULLIF($10, ''), NULLIF($11, ''))
ON CONFLICT (call_id) DO UPDATE
  SET ended_at      = EXCLUDED.ended_at,
      duration_secs = EXCLUDED.duration_secs,
      transcript    = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.transcript, calls.transcript),
      recording_url = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.recording_url, calls.recording_url),
      summary       = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.summary, calls.summary),
      intent        = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.intent, calls.intent),
      synced_at     = now();

'escalated' : null, $('Normalise the payload').first().json.transcript_json, $('Normalise the payload').first().json.recording_url, $json.summary, $json.intent]) }}
